widgets_values:
# 1. Enable the first frame and disable the last frame — this is image-to-video mode.
# 2. Disable the first frame and enable the last frame — this is last-frame-to-video mode.
# 3. Enable both the first and last frames — this is first-and-last-frame-to-video mode.
# 4. Disable both the first and last frames — this is text-to-video mode. (The image aspect ratio toggle must also be disabled at the same time.)

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D CG, semi-realistic anime style, a medium shot continuously frames the young woman shown in <Picture 1>, preserving her long straight silver-white hair, blue eyes, pale skin, white nurse uniform with short sleeves and pink cross emblems on the sleeve cuffs, white form-fitting stockings, white high-heeled shoes, white nurse cap with cross symbol, and glowing white halo above her head. The environment is a hot pink neon void with geometric white light shapes — a glowing cross and a triangle — that pulse and rotate slowly throughout, never changing in color or intensity. The camera follows her in a smooth continuous tracking shot with no cuts. [0.0s–1.0s] She begins in the crouching pose from <Picture 1>, one hand near her chin, fingers slightly curled against her lower lip. She does not move yet. She simply looks into the camera, her blue eyes half-lidded, unblinking, holding the viewer's gaze with quiet intensity. A single strand of silver hair drifts across her cheek in an imperceptible breeze. Her halo pulses once, slow and faint. [1.0s–2.5s] She rises slowly — not quickly, deliberately — unfolding from the crouch with controlled grace. Her stockings stretch taut along her legs, the fabric of her nurse uniform pulls and settles across her torso, and her silver hair lifts then drapes back past her shoulders one layer at a time. She does not look away from the camera during the entire motion. Her blue eyes remain locked on the viewer as her body rises into frame, her expression unreadable — not smiling, not cold, just watching. [2.5s–4.0s] She begins to walk forward, slowly, one heel in front of the other. Each step is measured and unhurried. Her hips sway with a subtle, natural rhythm. The camera retreats at her pace, maintaining the same framing. Her silver hair swings gently with each step, the ends brushing her lower back. She tilts her head slightly to the left — almost imperceptibly — and the corner of her mouth lifts into the faintest hint of a smile that does not reach her eyes. [4.0s–5.5s] She stops mid-stride, one foot still forward. She turns her head to the right, looking away from the camera for the first time. The pink neon light catches the side of her face — the curve of her jaw, the edge of her lower lip, the pale skin of her neck above the uniform collar. A strand of silver hair falls across her visible eye. She lets it stay there. Her halo glows slightly brighter against the pink background. Then, slowly, she turns her head back toward the camera, and as her blue eyes come back into view they are half-lidded again, steady, knowing. [5.5s–7.0s] She takes two more slow steps forward, closing the distance to the camera until she is nearly in a close-up. She shifts her weight onto her back foot and leans her upper body slightly forward, bringing her face closer to the lens. Her gloved right hand rises and extends one finger toward the camera in a slow, deliberate gesture — not pointing, more like almost touching the screen. Her blue eyes look up from the finger to the viewer, and the half-smile returns, this time a fraction wider. Her breath is faintly visible. [7.0s–8.0s] She holds the pose. Her lips part slightly and she says in a low, unhurried voice with a faint trace of a smile underneath: <d>[中文] 你还想跑吗？</d> Her blue eyes remain locked on the viewer. Her silver hair is settled. Her halo glows steadily. The pink neon light wraps around her silhouette. She does not blink as the video ends.

overall_soundscape: Slow, measured high-heeled footsteps on a hard surface during her approach, then silence when she stops. A faint ambient neon hum throughout.

non_diegetic_music: A single low cello note held at slow tempo, joined by sparse, spaced-out piano tones that create space and tension without resolving. The music sustains underneath the final line and cuts on the last frame.

nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **Image to Video** task (`MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo` node), which covers both:

- **t2va** (text-to-video), when no images are connected
- **fl2va** (first/last-frame image-to-video), when `first_frame` and/or `last_frame` are connected

**Key inputs**

- **first_frame / last_frame**: optional keyframes; the model generates the motion between them
- **prompt**: describe the shots, motion, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/

│   └── 📂 text_encoders/
│       └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)
